definitions.explanation: Describes behavior, actions, or a person that is rough, aggressive, or lacking in manners. Implies a combination of physical roughness and social crudeness.

examples.japanese: {粗暴|そぼう}な{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}いはやめなさい。
{彼|かれ}は{見|み}た{目|め}に{反|はん}して{粗暴|そぼう}な{人間|にんげん}だった。
examples.english: Contrary to his appearance, he was a rough person.

examples.japanese: {粗暴|そぼう}な{言動|げんどう}が{原因|げんいん}で{周囲|しゅうい}から{敬遠|けいえん}されるようになった。
examples.english: Due to his rough behavior and language, people started avoiding him.

notes:
USAGE:
{粗暴|そぼう} describes a combination of physical roughness and crude behavior. It is stronger than {乱暴|らんぼう} (rough, violent) in implying a persistent character trait rather than a single action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粗暴|そぼう}な{行為|こうい} (rough/violent behavior)
- {粗暴|そぼう}な{言動|げんどう} (rough words and actions)
- {粗暴|そぼう}な{性格|せいかく} (rough personality)
- {粗暴|そぼう}{犯|はん} (violent crime — legal term)
